game_title: Accumulator Pump – Moss Door Chamber Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Accumulator Pump: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal. Each round, skeleton miners strike the supply cache, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the total value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the supply cache from skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber: keep the total meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: total drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Accumulator Pump
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how total changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while total > 0.
